items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: All those drummers, like Buddy Rich and, you name it, everyone.

ctx.x: How did they come to select your band to play with these fellows at Carnegie Hall?

Because we had something that it was something new for the people, even for all the great jazz players. All those drummers, like Buddy Rich and, you name it, everyone. They flipped because they never heard so many .......
Your entire band was there, with Graciela, did you have any featured artists?
